name: get_current_weather
description: Get current weather conditions for a location. Uses IP-based geolocation if no coordinates provided. Data cached for 1 hour.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate (optional, auto-detected from IP if not provided)

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate (optional, auto-detected from IP if not provided)

name: get_weather_forecast
description: Get weather forecast for up to 16 days. Includes temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and weather conditions. Data cached for 1 hour.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate (optional, auto-detected from IP if not provided)

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate (optional, auto-detected from IP if not provided)

name: get_hourly_forecast
description: Get hourly weather forecast for up to 7 days. Includes detailed hourly conditions, temperature, precipitation probability, and more.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate (optional, auto-detected from IP if not provided)

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate (optional, auto-detected from IP if not provided)

hours.description: Number of hours ahead (1-168 for 7 days)

name: search_location_weather
description: Search for weather by city name or address. Returns weather data with resolved coordinates.

query.description: City name, address, or location query (e.g., 'Brisbane, Australia' or 'New York')
